attributes.additional_details: We urge the Government to change the proposed social media ban from under 16 to under 13 only. An under 16 ban goes too far teenagers need these spaces to learn, connect and grow. The existing under 13 rule is the right place to draw the line. Let's protect younger children without cutting teenagers off from the digital world.
attributes.background: to not make the ban for social media under 16,instead make it under 13

rejection.details:
We already have e petition open on this which you may wish to sign:

Social media ban for under-13s, not under-16s
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/784856
